selection_precondition: one or more selected curves/surfaces compatible with the command
units_and_options: canonical millimetres; options are owner-declared and parsed before the first mutation
undo_transaction_policy: one command session = one transaction; cancel/refusal writes nothing
dialog_result_mapping: menu and command line resolve to the same command_id; a disabled row reports the reason and does not mutate
disabled_reason: no verified backend owner for Silhouette; menu stays disabled
